3. **Communicate openly:** If the secret is truly urgent, involve the friend in the solution (e.g., "I’m worried about X—how can we handle this together?"). 4. **Own your mistakes:** If you do share, apologize sincerely and work to rebuild trust. --- ### **Why This Matters Beyond Religion:** Ethics aren’t about gods—they’re about **how humans live well together**.
